load_note: Available process snapshots are retained. A missing snapshot file means the PowerShell pipeline emitted no file, not an independently verified idle machine.
limits: Fixed simple three-part fixtures, not real ecological anatomy.
Tight lateral spacing can interpenetrate; depth layers themselves are separated by 40 units.
Dense crop submits 960 bodies; clipping/outside bounds are explicitly counted, not all bodies visible.
Geometric depth complexity and order-invariant pixels do not count actual GPU fragment invocations.
Opaque renderer only; terrain, causal effects, transparency, full memory accounting and application limits remain open.
Native and private-device timing contexts remain separate; concurrent workload can change measured times.
